svg.title: SwiftUI beginner infographic
svg.desc: An infographic explaining SwiftUI fundamentals: declarative UI, views, state, modifiers, and stacks, using an element flashcard app as the running example.
svg.text: You describe what the UI looks like — SwiftUI handles how to draw it.
Every screen, button, or text is a View. Views are lightweight and built from other views.
@State variables are watched by SwiftUI. Change one — the UI redraws automatically.

g.text: When you tap "Next" and this number changes from 0 to 1...
...the Image and Text using it both update on their own.

svg.text: Chain dot-modifiers to style any view. Each one returns a new view — order matters.
Arrange views with three simple containers — no Auto Layout, no constraints.
Your element flashcard app uses every concept above:
• @State tracks the current element and answer
• VStack and HStack arrange image, text, and buttons
• Modifiers style the image and buttons
